svg.title: ONB-S04 - Public and private together
svg.desc: Return independent findings; respect cross-function dependencies. Solid arrows are requests; dashed arrows are paired responses. Grey bars show handling intervals, not duration. Requests: solid / filled arrow. Responses: dashed / open arrow. Grey bars: handling intervals; timing is not to scale. Precondition: authorised business/dataset access and correct environment. Spain builds and logical contracts remain to be qualified. HTTP success is not readiness or activation. Failed / uncertain evidence returns an owned hold; observe original effects under ONB-08.
svg.text: Return independent findings; respect cross-function dependencies
Existing = documented API / guide; To qualify = logical handoff, no confirmed Spain contract.
opt | A known connection needs detail
opt | Known authorised dataset; inspect Sage setup only
opt | Certificate required for the selected purpose; use current evidence
opt | Missing authorised setup only; qualified connect effects
opt | Existing connection needs a supported requested update
Continue dependent checks only after valid NIF, current action authority and required certificate readiness
ONB-02/03/08 | Unconfirmed evidence holds only dependent work
Assess private work independently. Require later-phase, provider, authority and continuity gates before route
ONB-S04 | Public readiness does not activate private receiving
Requests: solid / filled arrow. Responses: dashed / open arrow. Grey bars: handling intervals; timing is not to scale.
Precondition: authorised business/dataset access and correct environment. Spain builds and logical contracts remain to be qualified.
HTTP success is not readiness or activation. Failed / uncertain evidence returns an owned hold; observe original effects under ONB-08.
